<!-- SCOPE NOTE (not rendered)
This session is the second half of the Define-XML material, split out of
sessions/define-xml.qmd deliberately.

  - define-xml.qmd  = hand-rolled Define-XML v2.1 with xml2. Teaching path.
  - this session    = the spec-driven production route.

Decisions already taken, do not relitigate:

  * defineR 0.0.6 supports Define-XML 2.0 ONLY. Its inst/extdata has a single
    version directory, 2.0.0/. There is no 2.1 schema, stylesheet or template.
    Define-XML 2.0 is April 2014; 2.1 is the current standard. The session must
    teach this gap explicitly rather than paper over it - the version lag between
    live tooling and the published standard IS the lesson.
  * defineR is pre-1.0 (0.0.6). Say so in the session. Do not present it as
    settled infrastructure.
  * Build cost: this session needs an artifact the repo does not have - a GLPX-001
    SDTM specification workbook. Do NOT invent the format: defineR ships templates
    at inst/extdata/2.0.0/metadata/templates/SDTM_METADATA.xlsx. Fill those in.
  * Pipeline convention applies: R/build_define.R alongside build_sdtm.R and
    build_adam.R, deterministic, output committed.
  * Closing move: metacore::define_to_metacore() reads the generated define.xml
    back, demonstrating the metadata round-trip. Exported and verified available.
  * defineR also ships define2-0.xsl; the xslt package (already a defineR
    dependency) can render define.xml to the browsable HTML a reviewer opens.
    The v2.1 package ships the matching define2-1.xsl.

Packages verified installed and loading: metacore 0.3.0, metatools 0.3.0,
defineR 0.0.6, xml2 1.6.0. renv.lock needs a snapshot once this session lands.
-->
